spacing_and_layout.layout_strategy: Mobile-first, soft bento grid. Avoid standard rigid rows. Use generous spacing (p-6 to p-12) to create a relaxed, engaging environment for kids. Keep cognitive load low.

surfaces.cards: bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-[#E2E8F0] shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#E2E8F0] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#E2E8F0] transition-all duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-[#4361EE] text-white rounded-2xl font-bold py-3 px-6 shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#3A53CC] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#3A53CC] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-[0_0px_0_0_#3A53CC] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FFD166] text-[#0B132B] rounded-2xl font-bold py-3 px-6 shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#E5BC5C] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_0_0_#E5BC5C] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all

components.forms: Use Shadcn components but heavily customize. Override border radii to rounded-2xl, increase input height to h-14 for kid-friendly tap targets, and use border-2 border-slate-200.
components.badges: rounded-full px-4 py-2 font-bold text-sm bg-[#FFD166]/20 text-[#D4A017]
components.emoji_buttons: Large touch targets (h-20 w-20) for reflection logs. Display giant emojis (bad/okay/good). Treat like radio buttons with a thick selected state (border-4 border-[#4361EE] bg-[#4361EE]/10 rounded-2xl).

hero_rocket.description: 3D claymorphism rocket ship, transparent background. Place in Student dashboard hero, welcoming header, or empty states to keep it playful.

reward_star.description: 3D claymorphism smiling star medal. Use on mission complete success screen or in the reflection log completion.

parent_child_learning.description: Parent and child studying. Recommended for the Login/Register split screen or Parent Dashboard empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts 'Fredoka' and 'Nunito' into the global index.css/html.
Use lucide-react for all standard iconography, but rely heavily on standard native emojis for the kids' UI (e.g., in badges and reflection forms).
CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on ALL interactive and key elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='student-mission-card', data-testid='log-reflection-submit').
Use Duolingo-style gamified tactile buttons (solid background + solid bottom shadow of darker shade, compressing on active state) instead of flat minimal buttons.
Ensure all implementation files are written in standard JS/JSX, not TypeScript (no .tsx).
Avoid the default Shadcn 'Vercel' look; do not use subtle grays and sharp corners. Strip standard shadcn borders and apply the rounded-3xl and border-2 patterns defined here.
